answer: Model honest agents as willow roots tangled into one trust graph; a sybil farm sits across a ridge, joined by only a handful of genuine attestation edges. Score standing by max trust-flow from an established seed set, not by headcount, so a thousand clones sharing that narrow bridge split one capped flow, each fake adding only a whisper. To lift the cap an attacker must earn real edges from distinct honest peers, which costs exactly as much as being honest.
